Picking lang-es immediately translates Home: 'HOLA LANGTESTER, ¿QUÉ VAMOS A ARREGLAR?', 'CREAR MI PLAN' button, 'PROYECTOS POPULARES' label, all 6 suggestion chips in Spanish (Cambiar un grifo de cocina, Remendar un agujero en tablaroca, etc), tab labels: PROYECTOS / SUMINISTROS / PRO-EARN / PERFIL (HOMIE stays HOMIE — intentional). Switching back to lang-en restores 'BUILD MY PLAN'. /support/ticket submit succeeded — backend returned 200, UI shows 'TICKET SENT' with reference #CEF38964. All AppMenu routes (FAQ, Knowledge Base, Contact, Terms, Privacy, Disclaimer) load with substantive content (>=275 chars).

minor.issue: Carryover cosmetic warning 'module bcrypt has no attribute __about__' in backend.err.log. No functional impact.

issues: WeatherBanner copy ('Get weather-smart tips / Tap to use your location, or add your ZIP/city in Profile.') remains in English even when language=es. This sits ON the Home screen which IS in the translated-chrome scope per spec. Minor — consider adding weather.* keys to locales/*.json and using t() inside WeatherBanner.

Bottom-tab 'SUMINISTROS' label is truncated to 'SUMINISTR...' on a 390-wide viewport because tabs have fixed equal width. Longer translations (e.g. Spanish, German, Portuguese) will get clipped in the tab bar. Consider numberOfLines=1 + adjustsFontSizeToFit on tab label, or reduce letterSpacing/font size for tabs in i18n languages.
